title: RNA Extraction and RT-qPCR of Human Lung Organoids
author: Morris Baumgardt
materials: Use the following program for reverse transcription:

steps.title: Collect Organoids
steps.instruction: Remove the entire organoid medium from the wells and collect the organoids.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL ice-cold base medium to the wells.
Collect Cultrex with organoids into a 2 mL tube.
Flush the well with an additional 1 mL base medium and collect this as well.

steps.title: Dissolve Cultrex and Pellet Cells
steps.instruction: Dissolve the Cultrex matrix and pellet the organoids via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Incubate the tube at 4 °C for 5 minutes to dissolve the Cultrex.
Centrifuge at 900 x g for 5 minutes at 4 °C.

steps.title: Isolate RNA
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from the organoid pellet using the RNeasy Mini Kit.

substeps.instruction: Carefully remove the supernatant.
Add 350 µL RLT Puffer + β-Mercaptoethanol to the organoid pellet.
Place the supernatant in a 1.5 mL safelock tube.
Isolate RNA using the Qiagen RNeasy Mini Kit (Cat No./ID 74104) following the manufacturer's protocol without changes.

steps.title: Assess RNA Quality and Quantity
steps.instruction: Verify the integrity and concentration of the isolated RNA.

substeps.instruction: Measure RNA quality via RIN (RNA Integrity Number) using a 2100 Bioanalyzer with the Agilent RNA 6000 Nano Kit (RIN should be at least 8; exemplary samples were 10).
Quantify RNA concentration using a NanoDrop by analyzing 1.5 µL of the RNA solution.

steps.title: Prepare RT Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the reverse transcription master mix on ice using the High Capacity cDNA Reverse Transcription Kit (Applied Biosciences).

substeps.instruction: Thaw kit components on ice.

Calculate volumes for the required number of reactions based on the following composition per reaction: 2 µL 10x RT Buffer, 0.8 µL 25x dNTP Mix (100mM), 2 µL 10x RT Random Primers, 1 µL MultiScribe™ RT, and 4.2 µL Nuclease-free H2O (Total 10 µL).

steps.title: Perform Reverse Transcription
steps.instruction: Synthesize cDNA from the isolated RNA.

substeps.instruction: Prepare an RNA/water solution in a thin wall PCR tube containing 1 µg RNA per 10 µL water (or 500 ng RNA per 10 µL water if concentration is low).
Prepare an RT control using water instead of RNA for each primer.
Add 10 µL of 2x reverse transcription master mix to each tube.
Add 80 µL H2O to each tube.

steps.title: Prepare qPCR Master Mix
steps.instruction: Prepare the TaqMan Gene Expression Assay master mix for each gene of interest.

substeps.instruction: Calculate volumes for the required number of reactions based on the following composition per reaction: 10 µL Gene Expression Master Mix, 4 µL H2O, and 1 µL TaqMan Gene Expression Assay (Total 15 µL).

steps.title: Run qPCR
steps.instruction: Perform the qPCR reaction in a Thermal Cycler.

substeps.instruction: Pipette 15 µL of the respective TaqMan gene expression assay master mix to the bottom of the well.
Pipet 5 µL of cDNA onto the upper wall of the well.
Seal the plate with a Clear Adhesive Film.
Centrifuge the plate at 1200 x g for 30 seconds.
Run the reaction in a Thermal Cycler.

steps.title: Quality Control and Analysis
steps.instruction: Ensure data validity through specific controls and reference genes.

substeps.instruction: Run each sample in duplicate.
Run housekeeping genes (e.g., GAPDH and ß-ACTIN) and the gene of interest on the same plate.
Include a water control for each primer.
Include the RT control from the reverse transcription step.
